gft 1.0.0 - gft
description: GitHub releases and git stashes through the gft command.
tier: declarative (no program of its own)
kind: shipped with tote
state: available
declared access:
  - derived:tty
  - env:GITHUB_TOKEN
  - exec:gft
  - fs:read:cwd
  - fs:write:any
  - fs:write:cwd
  - host:open-url
  - host:read:repos
  - net:*.githubusercontent.com
  - net:api.github.com
  - net:github.com
grant token: derived:tty,env:GITHUB_TOKEN,exec:gft,fs:read:cwd,fs:write:any,fs:write:cwd,host:open-url,host:read:repos,net:*.githubusercontent.com,net:api.github.com,net:github.com@aa61a534bc43
contributes:
  - command show: Show a GitHub release
  - command open: Open the releases page
  - command get: Download a release asset
  - command install: Install a release binary
  - item action release: Show the latest release
  - item action assets: List the release assets
  - item action notes: Show the release notes
  - item action stash-list: List stashes
  - item action stash-show: Show a stash
  - item action stash-drop: Drop a stash
  - item action stash-clean: Delete all stashes
available, not installed: tote plugin install gft
